{{Quote|Where are we, Master Obi-Wan?''"<br />"''The former homeworld of the Shi'kar, obliterated by a comet impact some time past. Its remains have become a lawless region stalked by scavengers, smugglers, and pirates.|Ahsoka Tano and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="TCW2" />}}
[[File:ShikarStraits-TCW2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Shi'kar Straits, former homeworld of the Shi'kar]]
The '''Shi'kar''' were a group whose [[Shi'kar homeworld|homeworld]]<ref name="TCW2" />&mdash;located in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Shi'kar Straits]]</ref>&mdash;was destroyed by a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] impact some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCW2" /> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] fractured into numerous pieces under the impact, eventually becoming an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] known as the [[Shi'kar Straits]]. Some of the larger [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] still contained ruined structures from the planet's past. By the time of the Clone Wars, the Shi'kar Straits had become a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]].<ref name="TCW2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shi'kar were created by [[Henry Gilroy]] for the [[The Clone Wars 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TCW2" /> on [[October 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-680/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-2|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #2}}</ref> The comic featured a [[Skirmish at the Shi'kar Straits|mission]] to the Shi'kar Straits undertaken by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were trying to track down the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]].<ref name="TCW2" />

When the comic storyline was adapted for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series in late [[2011]] and early [[2012]], the Jedi's visit to the Shi'kar Straits was not included.<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> As the television series takes precedence over the comic books within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the existence of the Shi'kar cannot be irrefutably confirmed.<ref name="Chee Facebook">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=295828993771367&id=201820953172172|author=[[Leland Chee|Keeper of the Holocron]]|date=2011-11-19|quote=As usual, the TV series supersedes the comic books in terms of continuity.}}</ref>
